Benefits

What you can expect

Impact

Work that matters. Every role here helps move more resources to highly effective charities.

People

We take care with every hire, then trust excellent people with meaningful decisions from the start.

Development

$5,000 a year for your professional development, whether that is courses, programmes, conferences or coaching.

Benefits

25 days of paid holiday a year plus public holidays - with managers who encourage you to use them - paid parental leave, a $5,000 wellbeing budget, and work remotely*

Ambition

We back ambitious ideas and give them the room and resources they need.

Growth

We’re aiming to grow 40% across our key metrics this year, creating opportunities for you to develop quickly and help shape what comes next.

*Benefits vary a little depending on where you are employed. Sick pay, pension and health cover differ by country, and your offer letter sets out exactly what applies to you

Our teams

Get to know our teams

Leadership team

Sets the strategy, decides where our funding goes, and answers for whether we hit our targets.

Operations

Keeps the organisation running and the money moving. Grantmaking, finance, compliance across our entities, hiring, and the systems everyone else depends on.

Growth

Helps more people discover effective giving and make it part of their lives. Marketing, product, community and partnerships sit here.

Product Engineering

The product engineering team maintains and improves our donation platform website and donor experience.

Research

Evaluates charities, funds and evaluators to decide what we recommend, and publishes the reasoning behind each recommendation.

Volunteers

Volunteers are a vital part of how we work. From event support, domain expertise to operational help their time and talent help us do far more than a small team could alone.
